mentions.name: localgcp
mentions.description: This tool is a local emulator for Google Cloud Platform, analogous to LocalStack/floci for AWS. It currently supports 14 GCP services, including Vertex AI and BigQuery, with the goal of seeing how much emulators can actually do.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am building localgcp - This is localstack / floci equivalent for Google Cloud platform : https://github.com/slokam-ai/localgcp - currently supports 14 services, including Vertex AI and BigQuery.
